newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-CULLINAN AND CRONJE PILE ON THE RUNS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CULLINAN AND CRONJE PILE ON THE RUNS.

text.p: Daryll Cullinan and Hansie Cronje both made 80's as South Africa put together a commanding 284 for seven in the sixth one day international at Centurion Park on Thursday.
The pair added 149 for the third wicket, a new South African record in one day internationals, beating the 145 of Cullinan and Gary Kirsten against the UAE in last year's World Cup.
Cronje promoted himself to fill the problem number three position and was in devastating touch from the start, hitting five boundaries from his first 15 balls.
He was eventually run out by the narrowest of margins by a fine throw from Greg Blewett, having made 80 from just 81 balls with six fours and two sixes.

Cullinan fell in the next over as he tried to hit Shane Warne back over his head for six and was comfortably taken by Mark Waugh on the long on boundary. Cullinan made 89 from 96 balls with eight fours.
Warne struck again with his next ball, having Jacques Kallis stumped by Ian Healy off a leg spinner that turned prodigiously.
Jonty Rhodes was run out for 10, but the innings regained its momentum thanks to Shaun Pollock who smashed 33 from 23 balls.
